# RflowZ

> RflowZ is an AI-powered research proposal writing platform for students, academics, and research teams. It helps users create structured research proposals with Ask Prof Z, OpenAlex source Library search, RAG-grounded literature synthesis, citation integrity checks, proposed framework diagrams, and export to DOCX, PDF, and PPTX.

## Official URLs

- Website: https://rflowz.com
- App (sign up / login): https://app.rflowz.com

- RflowZ vs ChatGPT: https://rflowz.com/rflowz-vs-chatgpt

## Who it is for

- Undergraduate and postgraduate students writing research proposals
- Academic researchers and supervisors
- Research teams preparing grant or thesis proposals

## Core features

- Ask Prof Z AI-assisted research proposal writing
- Unlimited Ask Prof Z (plan-dependent RAG grounding limits on Free)
- RAG academic document grounding (policy / literature)
- OpenAlex academic search and Source Library (plus policy/media sources)
- Citation integrity verification before export
- Proposed framework caption and Mermaid diagram
- Export to DOCX, PDF, and PPTX (plan-dependent)
- Free plan available on registration (no credit card required)
- TreZ thematic review and TAM transcript analysis (coming soon on higher plans)

Paid plans include a 5-day free trial. Standard and Professional subscription checkout may show as coming soon while rollout continues. Get started still available via app registration.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Is there a free plan?
A: Yes. New accounts start on the Free plan with 1 proposal per month, Unlimited Ask Prof Z, RAG for up to 10 documents, and 5 watermarked exports per month.

Q: Does RflowZ use OpenAlex?
A: Yes. Users search OpenAlex and other Library sources, attach them to literature work, and ground Ask Prof Z with RAG.

Q: How is RflowZ different from ChatGPT?
A: RflowZ provides a structured proposal workflow, OpenAlex Library, RAG grounding, citation integrity checks, and DOCX/PDF/PPTX export — not a general chat window alone.

Q: What export formats are supported?
A: DOCX and PDF on all eligible plans. PPTX export is available on Standard and Professional plans.

Q: How do I contact support?
A: Email support@rflowz.com or visit https://rflowz.com/contact
